blocks.orig: Shose Chalets offers a serene eco-retreat set in lush gardens just 5 kilometres from Moshi. The property features three chalets with spacious interiors, comfortable beds, and en-suite bathrooms – though you can also choose to stay in one of the farmhouse’s 17 rooms (each with private balconies and views of Mount Kilimanjaro) or camp within the compound. While here, you dine at the on-site restaurant serving fresh African and international cuisine, with most ingredients sourced directly from their own farms…a genuine farm-to-table experience! You can spend your days unwinding by the inviting pool and enjoy your evening at the cosy bar. With warm hospitality and a tranquil setting, Shose is the perfect base for relaxation or adventure.
blocks.html: Shose Chalets is a calm eco-retreat surrounded by lush gardens, only 5 kilometres from Moshi. There are three chalets with roomy interiors, comfortable beds and en-suite bathrooms – or you can stay in one of the farmhouse’s 17 rooms (all with private balconies and views of Mount Kilimanjaro), or camp on the grounds. Meals are served at the on-site restaurant, which offers fresh African and international dishes made largely with ingredients from the property’s own farms…true farm-to-table dining! Spend your days relaxing beside the inviting pool and your evenings in the cosy bar. Thanks to its warm hospitality and peaceful setting, Shose makes an ideal base whether you’re after rest or adventure.
